column1: # tier<TAB>name<TAB>triggers<TAB>command (see multi-cpu/fb-suites.tsv header). Commands follow run-all-tests.sh and r4.6-inherited/BUILD-NOTES.md; JSON receipts go to $FB_OUT.

column4: python3 -I tests/sync-model.py
python3 -I check-controller.py | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('controller:',d['status'],d['output'].splitlines()[-1]);assert d['status']=='pass'"
python3 -I check-memory.py | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('memory:',d['output'].splitlines()[-1],'|',d['identity_output'].splitlines()[-1])"; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} = 0
python3 -I tests/storage/s0/run.py | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);assert d['status']=='pass';print('S0:',d['s0']['checks'],'checks')"

python3 -I tests/r2/run.py > $FB_OUT/r2.json && python3 -I -c "import json;d=json.load(open('$FB_OUT/r2.json'));print('r2:',d['suite']['checks'],'checks, mutants caught',len(d['mutants_caught']),'decoder',d['decoder_tests'])" && python3 -I tests/s1dg/test_live.py "$(python3 -I -c "import json;print(json.load(open('$FB_OUT/r2.json'))['output_directory'])")/s1dg.dump" | tail -1

cd review-tests-r3 && python3 -I run.py 60000 > $FB_OUT/run.out 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -1 $FB_OUT/run.out | cut -c1-120; exit $rc
